correctness.rationale: Localization forces finite t-depth; the first nonzero residue exactly detects positivity. Normalizing an incomparable difference shows every common upper bound can be strictly lowered by multiplication by a scalar 0<lambda<1, proving the no-join theorem. Residue surjectivity then gives totality and forces the coefficient ring to be a DVR.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The recent source proves the localization construction and one complex no-join witness, while classical work proves division-closed lattice fields are total. Targeted searches did not locate the general leading-residue comparison law, the every-incomparable-pair no-join statement, or the exact R/tR=F and DVR boundary.

value.rationale: The result supplies an exact structural boundary for a new family of directed field orders, strengthens a single nonlattice example to a pairwise obstruction theorem, and yields broad corollaries for the universal construction and finite algebraic extensions.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
